releases.title: Legal governance and release integrity
releases.summary: PXA 1.1 strengthens legal document governance, release automation, dependency security, and consistent version information across applications and deployment artifacts.

added: Structured change fragments, safe previews, and agent-assisted authoring prepare consistent PXA release notes.

Legal governance now includes approval, resilient snapshots and recovery, Account review gates, audited evidence exports, enforced technical inventories, production retention gates, safe dry runs, and auditable Legal Holds.
improved: PXA applications, downloadable artifacts, and containers now expose validated matching product version information.
security: PXA now enforces dependency vulnerability gates, generates SPDX software inventories, and shows unresolved license decisions to authorized system administrators.
OpenAPI parsing and XML cryptography dependencies now use patched releases without known high-severity package advisories.
PXA release workflows now use immutable Node.js 24 action pins for reproducible CI, artifact generation, and container publishing.
Public PXA release notes now reject sensitive data and require explicit review of security entries.

releases.title: PXA 1.0.0
releases.summary: The first versioned Power Dox Automation release combines authenticated document design, persistent templates, PDF and spreadsheet workflows, migration tooling, administration, localization, and production observability.

added: Versioned product release notes and build information.
Central feature maturity metadata for Alpha, Beta, and Stable capabilities.
A notification center for releases and important account or system events.
Production logging, metrics, tracing, dashboards, and alerting foundations.
improved: Designer navigation, authentication, template persistence, localization, and scrollable editing workflows.
Account, administration, licensing, mail, documentation, and deployment workflows.
security: Feature preferences and notifications are evaluated in the authenticated user and organization context.
Operational telemetry applies tenant-safe privacy and sanitization boundaries.
